{{Quote|Now, before we hit a quasar or get sucked into a black hole, tell me why we didn't have to compute a course.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[Erling Tredway]]|<ref name="JH">''[[Jedi's Honor]]''</ref>}}
A '''quasar''' was an astronomical object. Quasars emitted light that was described by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] as [[Fire/Legends|burning]].<ref name="Rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref> Her brother [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] compared the [[Fosh/Legends|Fosh]] [[Vergere]]'s voice to being [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] and precise like the light received from a distant quasar.<ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref>
